options.text: Attaches custom domains to an already-deployed FHIRBridge environment's two public apps. Domain registration only (no certificate/SSL) -- run this first, add the CNAME/TXT records it reports, then re-run manage-custom-domain.ps1|sh with -Action Bind (or main.bicep's SSL checkboxes) to actually issue and bind the certificate.

elements.name: namePrefix
elements.label: Deployment name prefix
elements.toolTip: The namePrefix used when main.bicep was originally deployed (e.g. "segue5") -- this is what the target app/environment names are derived from.

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

elements.name: fhirbridgeAppDomain
elements.label: FHIRBridge app domain
elements.toolTip: e.g. app.example.com. Leave blank to skip attaching a domain to this app.

elements.name: demoAppDomain
elements.label: Demo app domain
elements.toolTip: e.g. demo.example.com. Leave blank to skip attaching a domain to this app.
